Position sizing: 89 shares × $249.30 = $22,188 = 21.2% of equity, and worst-case stop loss costs 89 × $17.45 = $1,553 = 1.48% of equity — within 1-2% risk budget.
trades.exit_plan: Stop hard at $231.85 (no discretion). Target $310 over 3-6 months as margins normalize toward prior peak levels. Thesis-break exit: if quarterly revenue growth decelerates below 10% YoY or management lowers full-year guidance at Aug 4 earnings. Time stop: if price is flat or negative after 8 weeks with no progress toward target, re-evaluate and consider exiting to redeploy. Trail stop up by 1× ATR increments as price advances. Consider holding past 1-year mark for LTCG if position is profitable and thesis intact.
